objective.primary_goal: Give CYI an intensely vibrant youth identity across its complete web platform.

audience_change.do: Find a community, explore an experience, listen, reflect or connect.

audience.primary: CYI youth, members, volunteers and supporters.
audience.context_of_use: Mobile discovery and returning desktop use.

message.governing_idea: Made for more: faith is alive in people, creativity and service.

creative_direction.visual_thesis: A midnight festival canvas gives authentic CYI moments a luminous frame.
creative_direction.composition: Oversized type balances an asymmetric arched photo collage, followed by distinct light and saturated chapters.
creative_direction.typography: Local Barlow Condensed, local Manrope and one Georgia italic accent.
creative_direction.motion: Shared pausable carousel and marquee, with reduced-motion support.

deliverables.master: Complete responsive website in the existing private Sites project.

production.authorization: Explicit user request for a much more vibrant redesign and publication of the existing work.

assumptions: Preserve all 113 views, functional navigation and the existing private audience.
